This article compares the statistical distribution of hospital admission lengths (indlæggelsesperiode) across Danish regions and individual hospitals for the period spanning September 1, 2022, to August 31, 2023. The data, compiled by the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]], provides a detailed breakdown of minimums, first quartiles (Q1), medians, and third quartiles (Q3) to illustrate how long patients remain admitted across different healthcare facilities [^src1].

Rigshospitalet stands out as a massive outlier, recording the longest admission times by a significant margin. Its median admission length is 26.00 days, which is more than three times the national median for Denmark of 8.00 days [^src1]. Furthermore, Rigshospitalet's Q3 reaches 52.00 days, indicating that a quarter of its patients experience exceptionally prolonged stays [^src1]. 

Conversely, the shortest median admission times are shared by several hospitals, which all report a median of 7.00 days. These include Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital, Bornholms Hospital, Sjællands Universitetshospital, Holbæk Sygehus, Hospitalsenhed Midt, Regionshospitalet Randers, and Regionshospital Nordjylland [^src1]. Among these, Bornholms Hospital demonstrates the tightest distribution for longer stays, recording the lowest Q3 in the dataset at just 9.00 days [^src1].

Another notable outlier is Regionshospitalet Horsens, which is the only facility in the dataset to report a minimum admission time greater than zero, logging a minimum of 1.00 day compared to the 0.00 days reported by all other regions and hospitals [^src1]. Meanwhile, Sygehus Lillebælt and Rigshospitalet show the highest Q1 values (7.00 and 9.00 days, respectively), suggesting that even their shorter stays are longer than those at other facilities [^src1].

Because this dataset covers only a single reporting period (2022–2023), it is not possible to identify longitudinal trends, improvements, or declines in admission lengths. Additionally, the table does not specify any clinical targets, thresholds, or standards for admission durations, meaning no facilities can be evaluated as meeting or missing specific performance goals.

Summary: Tabellen dokumenterer indlæggelsesperiodens kvartiler for 2022–2023 og viser, at Rigshospitalets median var 26 dage — mere end tre gange så lang som landsgennemsnittet — og at Regionshospitalet Horsens havde den højeste Q3 (21 dage), hvilket signalerer særlig længere forløb i nogle enheder.
